change: Add the private profit-analysis worker lifecycle and graceful shutdown drain beside the existing inventory and assistant workers. Existing generic queue handlers, node recovery, inventory and assistant behavior remain unchanged.
scope: Worker role only; ENABLE_PROFIT_ANALYSIS_WRITES and ENABLE_PROFIT_ANALYSIS_WORKER must both be exactly true. No generic ai_jobs registration, scheduling, registry seeding, migration registration or production activation.
privacy: Bounded metadata-only discovery; private workspace/user/full-scope journals. Every claim, dispatch and result publication reacquires fresh identity, permissions and source ownership. Errors and logs use fixed codes.
execution: Provider work is outside SQL transactions and behind a durable fixed-UUID dispatch fence. Expired dispatched work becomes unknown, never automatic retry. Paid replies may finish their authorized lease-bound checkpoint after a stop; canceled/revoked/expired ownership still fences writes. Ready results recover locally without another provider call. Save uses a separate UUID and source/result/report CAS and never writes financial facts.
configuration: Reuse exact saved finance configuration; actual approved Qingdao Skill/model evidence is still required. Default approval resolver is empty; no borrowed Listing Skill, invented fallback prompt or provider call is enabled.
verification: Frozen source, related tests, full application plus changed-test types, protected baselines and server bundles are recorded in the separate durable-profit integration receipt. This source review does not replace native MySQL, authenticated browser, provider or release acceptance.
